en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a riverside view with a paddle steamboat labeled 'Meißen' on the river. On the hill above the river, an impressive Gothic castle and cathedral dominate the skyline with high spires and historic architecture. Houses and smaller buildings line the waterway below the castle. The caption at the bottom reads 'Meißen a. d. Elbe. Albrechtsburg u. Dom.'
